channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap for version 1.2 was created and its requirements were defined, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light‑node model. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: An old AI submodule was removed and references to it were cleared from documentation, while the network’s backup and storage handling were improved and new logging was added. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: New investor lockout scenarios and related calculations were added, along with fixes, tests, and formula refactoring; the SDK gained a payout address feature and was adjusted to run on internal servers; a numeric keypad component was added to a client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: A milestone audit was completed and documentation was updated; the wallet now tracks job counts and includes new API bindings; a payout address feature was added to accounts and nodes; request handling was improved with idempotency support. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: The SDK introduced service registration, rotating refresh tokens, and secured password handling with email indexing; build processes were forced to use internal servers; the dashboard received design and accessibility fixes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 9 November
item.description: Password handling was secured by adding hashing and email indexing, with tests confirming the changes. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding.
